 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1),

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999),
rets AS (
  SELECT sum(r.refund_net) AS v FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND s.store_id <> 999)
SELECT round(sales.v - rets.v, 2) AS net_sales_eur, sales.v AS gross_of_returns, rets.v AS returns FROM sales, rets
